chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: What is the expected major product when Sodium phenoxide (PhONa) is treated with Iodomethane (CH3I)?
questions.explanation: Treating Sodium phenoxide (PhONa) with Iodomethane (CH3I) yields Anisole (methoxybenzene) + NaI. Rationale: Phenoxide acts as an SN2 nucleophile, displacing iodide from methyl iodide.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of Diethyl ether (CH3CH2OCH2CH3) into 2 equivalents Iodoethane (CH3CH2I) + H2O?
questions.explanation: To convert Diethyl ether (CH3CH2OCH2CH3) into 2 equivalents Iodoethane (CH3CH2I) + H2O, the appropriate reagent is Excess concentrated HI / heat. Rationale: Protonation of ether oxygen followed by two successive SN2 displacements by iodide yields alkyl iodide.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: What is the expected major product when tert-Butyl methyl ether is treated with Concentrated HBr / 0°C?
questions.explanation: Treating tert-Butyl methyl ether with Concentrated HBr / 0°C yields tert-Butyl bromide + Methanol. Rationale: Protonation followed by SN1 ionization yields the 3° carbocation, captured by bromide to form tert-butyl bromide.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 1-Methylcyclohexene into 1-Methylcyclohexene oxide?
questions.explanation: To convert 1-Methylcyclohexene into 1-Methylcyclohexene oxide, the appropriate reagent is mCPBA in CH2Cl2. Rationale: Peroxy acid transfers an electrophilic oxygen across the double bond in a single concerted step.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: What is the expected major product when 2,2-Dimethyloxirane is treated with Methanol (CH3OH) / trace H2SO4?
questions.explanation: Treating 2,2-Dimethyloxirane with Methanol (CH3OH) / trace H2SO4 yields 2-Methoxy-2-methyl-1-propanol. Rationale: Protonated epoxide possesses carbocation character at the 3° carbon; methanol attacks the more substituted carbon.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 2,2-Dimethyloxirane into 1-Methoxy-2-methyl-2-propanol?
questions.explanation: To convert 2,2-Dimethyloxirane into 1-Methoxy-2-methyl-2-propanol, the appropriate reagent is Sodium methoxide (NaOCH3) in methanol. Rationale: Methoxide attacks the less sterically hindered primary carbon via an SN2 mechanism.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: Which starting material will react with 1. Ethylene oxide; 2. Aqueous H3O+ to yield 2-Phenylethanol as the major product?
questions.explanation: Phenylmagnesium bromide reacts with 1. Ethylene oxide; 2. Aqueous H3O+ to yield 2-Phenylethanol. Rationale: Organomagnesium nucleophile attacks the strained ethylene oxide ring, lengthening the chain by two carbons.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: What is the expected major product when 2 equivalents Ethanethiol (CH3CH2SH) is treated with I2 / aqueous NaOH?
questions.explanation: Treating 2 equivalents Ethanethiol (CH3CH2SH) with I2 / aqueous NaOH yields Diethyl disulfide (CH3CH2S-SCH2CH3) + 2 NaI. Rationale: Mild oxidation of thiols couples sulfur atoms to form a stable covalent disulfide bridge.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: Which starting material will react with Iodomethane (CH3I) to yield Trimethylsulfonium iodide ((CH3)3S+ I-) as the major product?
questions.explanation: Dimethyl sulfide ((CH3)2S) reacts with Iodomethane (CH3I) to yield Trimethylsulfonium iodide ((CH3)3S+ I-). Rationale: Nucleophilic sulfur attacks methyl iodide in an SN2 reaction to form a stable trialkylsulfonium salt.

questions.chapter_title: Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
questions.question: What is the expected major product when Dimethyl sulfide ((CH3)2S) is treated with 1 equivalent NaIO4 in water (0°C)?
questions.explanation: Treating Dimethyl sulfide ((CH3)2S) with 1 equivalent NaIO4 in water (0°C) yields Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO). Rationale: Controlled oxidation of thioethers with sodium periodate yields the sulfoxide without over-oxidation to sulfone.
